items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: you're talking about Paul Whiteman, you're talking about Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: Right, polite phrase. We had the same thing. The world's greatest pimps came out of New Orleans, but what they did, they went to Houston, Texas and taught the guys in Houston how to pimp and how to lay out. And the guys from Houston, Texas went to New York and they turned New York on. The world's greatest pimps were trained by the pimps from New Orleans who went to Houston and taught them and they went to New York. Well, you're talking about in the 30s and the 40s, you're talking about the jazz age, you're…
So, who were the great pimps from New Orleans?
